title: Grateful Dead Live at San Jose Civic Auditorium on 1972-08-20
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Pure soundboard capture with a powerful Truckin'→The Other One sequence, tight jams and overall high energy despite occasional snare‑mix quirks.
ai_review.review: The August ’72 show delivers an epic second‑set highlight in the seamless Truckin' into The Other One transition, backed by strong performances of Bird Song, Playing In The Band and Stella Blue. The recording is largely a clean soundboard source, though listeners note a forward snare mix early on and occasional uneven patches. Overall the set’s energy and musicianship shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both the performance (epic Truckin'→Other One, strong jams) and the soundboard quality; only one review is mixed, resulting in a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clean and crisp pure soundboard recording; occasional uneven patches noted, snare drum overly forward early in the set, Phil's bass prominent in mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second‑set momentum with an epic Truckin' into The Other One transition and energetic jams that carry the show to a high point, despite early mix issues.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is prominent in the mix, adding intensity to the vocal harmonies.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's snare drum sits too high in the mix early on, causing a harsh edge that eases later in the set.
